_source: Engine.vb: checkMaceImpact (Score += damage * 1000) and checkAngelHit (HP -= 1). Root.vb: gameSpeed, 1.0 at the start and again on every Reset. Input.vb getKeyboard: Minus gameSpeed -= 0.01 and Equals += 0.01 every frame the key is held, never below 0 (UNI-T52); the original only drew it, the port runs every step at it (BIBLE D13, V20).
